stories.title: U.S. and Iran exchange strikes, underscoring the fragility of the ceasefire
stories.description: President Trump accused Iran of violating their framework agreement, and Tehran threatened to halt negotiations with the U.S. entirely. Meanwhile, violence continued between Israel and Hezbollah.

stories.title: New strikes test the Iran ceasefire
stories.description: The ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran is being tested after new attacks in the Strait of Hormuz. Mideast expert Paul Salem explains what's happened and whether the deal can still hold.

stories.title: Israel strikes southern Lebanon as Hezbollah condemns new deal
stories.description: Strikes have killed at least one person, state media say a day after Lebanon and Israel signed a framework agreement.

stories.title: US strikes Iran after attack on cargo ship
stories.description: Iran accuses the US of violating their deal and says it struck targets linked to American forces in response.

stories.title: Trump accuses Iran of ceasefire breach after Strait of Hormuz attack
stories.description: A Singapore-flagged ship was struck crossing the waterway on Thursday, prompting a large-scale evacuation to be paused.

stories.title: UN nuclear chief says inspectors will visit Iran sites as part of war deal
stories.description: Rafael Grossi says the IAEA is "working on modalities" but an Iranian minister says such access would only be part of a final deal with the US.

stories.title: UN pauses Strait of Hormuz evacuation plan after cargo ship attacked
stories.description: The ship was reportedly struck by an "unknown projectile" near Oman but no casualties were reported.

stories.title: Dozens of ships head through Strait of Hormuz after US-Iran deal
stories.description: Traffic in the waterway has risen since the US and Iran signed a deal aimed at ending the war, including 42 ships on Saturday alone.

stories.title: Israeli troops kill two in south Lebanon after lull in fighting, authorities say
stories.description: Israel's military says the two men were Hezbollah operatives, but the Iran-backed group accuses it of a ceasefire violation.

stories.title: Iran says no new commitments on nuclear sites after Vance says inspectors to be invited back
stories.description: Iran's foreign ministry says it made "no new commitments" on nuclear inspections after talks in Switzerland.

stories.title: First round of US-Iran talks ends with encouraging progress, mediators say
stories.description: The US-Iran talks began on Sunday in Switzerland, after last week's agreement, which includes a commitment to reach a final deal within 60 days.

stories.title: Israel and Hezbollah continue strikes despite ceasefire agreement
stories.description: At least 20 people have reportedly been killed by Israeli air strikes as the Israeli military said Hezbollah had fired at Israeli troops in southern Lebanon.

stories.title: Tehran targets Bahrain and Kuwait after US attacks
stories.description: The ceasefire between Iran and the United States appears increasingly fragile on Sunday, following a new exchange of strikes. stories.title: Albania's "Flamingo revolution": Trump-linked luxury resort plan triggers mass protests
stories.description: Protests in Albania entered their fifth week on Saturday, with demonstrations that began in May over a planned luxury resort project linked to the Trump family. stories.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guard on Sunday launched attacks targeting Bahrain and Kuwait in response to US air strikes on 10 Iranian sites. stories.title: US and Iran trade strikes days after peace agreement
stories.description: Just days after signing a memorandum of understanding, the US and Iran have traded strikes.

stories.title: In Lebanon, framework agreement signed with Israel spurs protest, criticism
stories.description: Anger over deal that does not force Israeli troops to withdraw from occupied land after months of deadly attacks.

stories.title: Israel strikes Lebanon, testing days-old peace deal
stories.description: Hezbollah calls the deal a surrender as Israeli forces stay put and continue striking the south.

stories.title: Iran's supreme leader says legal cases must be pursued against US, Israel over 'child killings, war crimes'
stories.description: Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei said on Sunday that legal cases must be pursued against the US and Israel over “child killings and war crimes” in Iran. stories.title: Aramco helicopter crash kills 14 in Saudi Arabia
stories.description: A helicopter crash in Saudi Arabia killed 14 Saudi citizens on Sunday, the kingdom’s official press agency reported, adding that the aircraft belonged to state oil giant Aramco. stories.title: UAE, Iran to resume flights from July 1, official says
stories.description: TEHRAN: Direct flights between Iran and the United Arab Emirates will resume next week after aviation authorities in both countries approved the route, following a multi-month suspension of operations amid regional military escalations. stories.title: US and Iran trade strikes, putting fresh strain on Mideast ceasefire
stories.description: The United States and Iran traded military strikes after Washington on Friday accused Tehran of attacking a cargo ship, jeopardising a fragile ceasefire as diplomats struggle to contain the Middle East war. stories.title: Iran warns ships not to bypass its chosen Hormuz route
stories.description: At the moment, Iran insists ships transiting the strait pass through a corridor close to its own shores, though this week dozens of vessels have travelled along the opposite side of the waterway, hugging the Omani coast

stories.title: West Asia war LIVE: Iran cancelled participation in technical talks over recent attacks, official tells state TV
stories.description: Iran warns challenge to Strait of Hormuz routes will spike West Asia tensions

stories.title: Israel strikes south Lebanon despite framework agreement to end hostilities
stories.description: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun told his U.S. counterpart, Donald Trump, on June 27, that his country “would assume its responsibilities” in implementing the framework agreement, which was signed in Washington on June 26, after five rounds of talks

stories.title: DGS withdraws restriction on the movement of Indian ships in the Strait of Hormuz
stories.description: The advisory against deploying Indian seafarers in the conflict zones also stands withdrawn

stories.title: Iran attacks Bahrain, Kuwait following U.S. strikes, threatens to end talks to end war
stories.description: An interim deal between the U.S. and Iran to end the war called for the Strait, which once saw a fifth of the world's oil and natural gas pass through it, to see transits resume

stories.title: Hezbollah chief calls U.S.-Israel-Lebanon deal 'grave blunder', deems it null and void
stories.description: Hezbollah leader Qassem called on the government to withdraw from "its sins that are ruining Lebanon".

stories.title: Iraq ready to host meeting between Iran, Gulf Arab nations — top diplomat
stories.description: According to Hussein, as Iraq maintains "perfect relations with the United States," Baghdad "expresses its readiness to help both Tehran and Washington put an end to the war between them."

stories.title: Iran warns third countries against interfering in Hormuz Strait — top diplomat
stories.description: According to Abbas Araghchi, navigation through the Strait of Hormuz could return to pre-conflict levels within 30 days, provided all existing obstacles were removed
